title: Decide by precedent: prediction on each row, lanes, bulk reject, reason preset
body:
## Summary
The scan already predicts each verdict and names the precedent, and the inbox has loaded it, but a triager sees it only after opening each card. Show the prediction on every row, group open cards into lanes by predicted verdict and reason, and let one confirmed judgment reject (or snooze) a lane, with the reason preset from the precedent and the count carrying its predicate.

## Description
The pane (Detail.jsx:106-114) shows 'Predicted: Reject, closest precedent "Add a loyalty points ledger" rejected as not-our-direction'. The list does not, so a triager clears a push one card at a time, opening each to discover that several repeat a decision the team already made. precedent.js derives everything from fields on the loaded card: predictedReason parses only the store's own `closest precedent ... as <code>` line (never a counter-precedent, never free text), lanesOf groups open cards, lanePredicate states the lane in words. Following the registry's triage-queues/bulk-triage technique (read for this card): selection is a set of identities captured at click time, the confirmation names the predicate and not only the count, and the asymmetry is encoded: predicted-reject and predicted-defer lanes get a bulk action (reject through the existing 6 s undo window, snooze), predicted-accept never does, because an accept creates a Jira issue. The reject still goes through RejectDialog, preset but editable.

## Flow
- Write inbox-precedent.test.mjs from the cases; all fail.
- Add precedent.js (predictedReason, lanesOf, lanePredicate, checkLane).
- Row mark in InboxList, the line in RowSignals' screen-reader text.
- Lane chips above each push group; a lane's Reject opens RejectDialog with initialReason and the predicate line; Snooze uses the bulk SnoozeStep.
- Fixture: a second predicted reject with the same reason so the lane shows; docs/forge-app.md inbox section.
- Gates: forge:typecheck, forge:test, forge:build-ui, fixture journey.

## Expected impact
A push whose repeats are known clears in one confirmed step per lane instead of one open-read-decide loop per card, and the demo shows the learning loop paying off in the first minute. Risk: easier agreement can inflate the trust slices' agreement rate; bounded by no accept lane, the predicate in the confirmation, and the undo window.

## Evaluation
Claim: the triager sees every prediction in the list and can act on a homogeneous lane in one confirmed step, never on accepts.
Before: 0 of 8 cases pass
After: 8 of 8 (predicted)
Method: gate - acceptance tests
Result: better
Gate: policy-loosen
evidence: Detail.jsx:106-114 `<dt>Predicted</dt> ... card.predicted_why && <div className="dwr-why">`; grep of InboxList.jsx and parts.jsx for predict: no match; dialogs.jsx:238 `const [reason, setReason] = useState('')`; predict.mjs:100 `${label} "${p.title}" (${p.fp}) ${p.status}${p.reason ? ` as ${p.reason}` : ''}`; fixture.js:218 'rejected as not-our-direction'; registry technique triage-queues/bulk-triage (identity-survives-reuse, count-carries-predicate, bulk-dismiss is not bulk-accept).
impact_why: precedent-driven bulk triage; excluded: bulk-agreeing with predictions inflates the 90% agreement that earns L1
predicted_why: no precedent; critic voided it as policy-loosen (triage.md:166-169) - needs a trust rule that discounts bulk-agreed verdicts first

title: run status re-implements outbox pending selection; one shared selector
body:
## Summary
skill/scripts/lib/runs.mjs copies the outbox pending selection from skill/scripts/lib/sync.mjs instead of sharing it.

## Description
cbf0266 added run status; the builder could not call outbox (it writes) and sync.mjs was outside its write set, so the selection exists twice, pinned only by one equality test.

## Flow
- extract a read-only pendingForOutbox(db) in sync.mjs
- outbox and runs.mjs both call it; delete the copy

## Expected impact
One rule for what gets pushed; a future outbox filter cannot drift from run status.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one implementation of the pending rule
Before: 2 implementations
After: not built
Method: simulation - not built in this run
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: cbf0266 runs.mjs (copy of sync.mjs:141-148 selection); test case 3 in skill/scripts/tests/run-status.test.mjs pins equality

## Summary

## Description
The Confluence byline issues one statement per matching card; the rest of the store reads in sets since 2923172.

- batch the read like inbox.list

Byline popup cost flat in the number of cards.

title: Rebuild context-map.json: forge-app names apps/forge/, 14 of 274 files mapped
body:
## Summary
context-map.json is the provisional hand-derived map of 2026-10-27; forge-app points at apps/forge/, which does not exist.

## Description
The challenge cohort had to be hand-composed. The deterministic refresh (personas-door contexts refresh) made it worse: it dropped every trailing-slash directory entry (skill/references/, skill/lenses/, skill/schema/, docs/contracts/) as gone files, and was reverted.

## Flow
- edit the map by hand: forge-app -> forge/src/, add forge-ui (forge/static/app/), tools, docs
- validate every path exists, then contexts sync

## Expected impact
Coverage and challenge picking work on the real tree.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - files mapped
Before: 14 of 274
After: not built
Method: simulation - not built in this run
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence: context-map.json forge-app.file_paths = ["apps/forge/"]; coverage.mjs --challenge: 3 eligible, forge-app 1 file
